Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # <!-- {"role": "tool", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPanel widget for KosDWM PyQt5 version\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom PyQt5.QtWidgets import (\n    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton, \n    QComboBox, QFrame, QMenu, QAction, QButtonGroup\n)\nfrom PyQt5.QtCore import Qt, QTimer\nfrom PyQt5.QtGui import QFont\n\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n\nclass Panel(QFrame):\n    \"\"\"\n    Top panel with gadgets, menus, clock, and desktop switcher\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, parent=None):\n        super().__init__(parent)\n        # Height is controlled by parent window (30px)\n        self.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QFrame {\n                background-color: #333333;\n                border: none;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 8px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #555555;\n            }\n            QLabel {\n                color: white;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Setup desktop manager\n        from src.desktop_manager_pyqt5 import DesktopManager\n        self.desktop_manager = DesktopManager(self)\n        self.desktop_manager.desktop_changed.connect(self.on_desktop_changed)\n        \n        # Setup menu manager\n        from src.menus_pyqt5 import MenuManager\n        self.menu_manager = MenuManager(self)\n        \n        self.setup_ui()\n        \n        # Timer for clock updates\n        self.timer = QTimer()\n        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.update_time)\n        self.timer.start(1000)\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the panel UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(5, 2, 5, 2)\n        layout.setSpacing(5)\n        \n        # Left side: Menus button with dynamic menu\n        self.menus_button = QPushButton(\"\u2630\")\n        self.menus_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.menus_button.setMenu(self.build_menus_menu())\n        layout.addWidget(self.menus_button)\n        \n        # Desktop buttons\n        self.desktop_group = QButtonGroup(self)\n        self.desktop_buttons = []\n        for i in range(4):\n            btn = QPushButton(str(i + 1))\n            btn.setFixedWidth(25)\n            btn.setFixedHeight(22)\n            btn.setCheckable(True)\n            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, d=i: self.switch_desktop(d))\n            self.desktop_group.addButton(btn)\n            self.desktop_buttons.append(btn)\n            layout.addWidget(btn)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Load gadgets\n        self.load_gadgets()\n        \n        # Set current desktop\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n    \n    def load_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Load gadgets into the panel\"\"\"\n        from src.gadgets_pyqt5 import GadgetManager\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Load dynamic menus\n        for menu_data in self.menu_manager.load_menus():\n            if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"branch\" and menu_data.get(\"items\"):\n                # Create submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                for item in menu_data[\"items\"]:\n                    if item[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, p=item[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                        )\n                    elif item[\"type\"] == \"leaf\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, m=item: self.menu_manager._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                        )\n            else:\n                # Single item\n                action = menu.addAction(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                    action.triggered.connect(\n                        lambda checked, p=menu_data[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                    )\n        \n        menu.addSeparator()\n        menu.addAction(\"Exit\", self.window().close)\n        \n        return menu\n    \n    def open_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Open gadget configuration\"\"\"\n        from src.gadget_config_pyqt5 import GadgetConfigDialog\n        \n        dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self)\n        if dialog.exec_():\n            self.load_gadgets()\n", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 156, "timestamp": 1784843550.1465557, "date": "2026-07-23", "name": "ReadFile"} -->

Update every 2 seconds\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the panel UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(5, 2, 5, 2)\n        layout.setSpacing(5)\n        \n        # Left side: Menus button with dynamic menu\n        self.menus_button = QPushButton(\"\u2630\")\n        self.menus_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.menus_button.setMenu(self.build_menus_menu())\n        layout.addWidget(self.menus_button)\n        \n        # Window switcher dropdown\n        self.window_combo = QComboBox()\n        self.window_combo.setPlaceholderText(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\")\n        self.window_combo.setEnabled(self.window_manager.is_available())\n        self.window_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.on_window_selected)\n        layout.addWidget(self.window_combo)\n        \n        # Desktop buttons\n        self.desktop_group = QButtonGroup(self)\n        self.desktop_buttons = []\n        for i in range(4):\n            btn = QPushButton(str(i + 1))\n            btn.setFixedWidth(25)\n            btn.setFixedHeight(22)\n            btn.setCheckable(True)\n            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, d=i: self.switch_desktop(d))\n            self.desktop_group.addButton(btn)\n            self.desktop_buttons.append(btn)\n            layout.addWidget(btn)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Load gadgets\n        self.load_gadgets()\n        \n        # Set current desktop\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        \n        # Initial window list population\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_window_list(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the window switcher dropdown with current windows\"\"\"\n        if not self.window_manager.is_available():\n            return\n        \n        # Get current selection before clearing\n        current_id = None\n        current_index = self.window_combo.currentIndex()\n        if current_index > 0:  # 0 is placeholder\n            current_data = self.window_combo.itemData(current_index)\n            if current_data:\n                current_id = current_data.get('id')\n        \n        # Block signals while updating\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(True)\n        self.window_combo.clear()\n        \n        # Add placeholder\n        self.window_combo.addItem(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\", None)\n        \n        # Get windows and add to dropdown\n        windows = self.window_manager.get_windows()\n        selected_index = 0\n        \n        for i, window in enumerate(windows):\n            # Truncate long titles\n            title = window['title']\n            if len(title) > 35:\n                title = title[:32] + \"...\"\n            \n            # Add desktop number prefix if not on current desktop\n            display_text = title\n            if window['desktop'] != -1:  # -1 means sticky/all desktops\n                current_desktop = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n                if window['desktop'] != current_desktop:\n                    display_text = f\"[{window['desktop']+1}] {title}\"\n            \n            index = self.window_combo.count()\n            self.window_combo.addItem(display_text, window)\n            \n            # Restore selection if this window was selected\n            if current_id and window['id'] == current_id:\n                selected_index = index\n        \n        # Restore selection\n        self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(selected_index)\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(False)\n    \n    def on_window_selected(self, index):\n        \"\"\"Handle window selection from dropdown\"\"\"\n        if index <= 0:  # Placeholder selected\n            return\n        \n        window = self.window_combo.itemData(index)\n        if window and 'id' in window:\n            # Activate the window\n            self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n    \n    def load_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Load gadgets into the panel\"\"\"\n        from src.gadgets_pyqt5 import GadgetManager\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n        # Update window list to show new desktop's windows\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Load dynamic menus\n        for menu_data in self.menu_manager.load_menus():\n            if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"branch\" and menu_data.get(\"items\"):\n                # Create submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                for item in menu_data[\"items\"]:\n                    if item[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, p=item[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                        )\n                    elif item[\"type\"] == \"leaf\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, m=item: self.menu_manager._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                        )\n            else:\n                # Single item\n                action = menu.addAction(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                    action.triggered.connect(\n                        lambda checked, p=menu_data[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                    )\n        \n        menu.addSeparator()\n        menu.addAction(\"Exit\", self.window().close)\n        \n        return menu\n    \n    def open_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Open gadget configuration\"\"\"\n        from src.gadget_config_pyqt5 import GadgetConfigDialog\n        \n        dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self)\n        if dialog.exec_():\n            self.load_gadgets()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 156, "timestamp": 1784843562.0606847, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 23145, "response_tokens": 2422} -->

Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Activate the window\n            success = self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            \n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n            \n            # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # <!-- {"role": "assistant", "content": "<WriteFile>\n<fileName>src/panel_pyqt5.py</fileName>\n<contentOfFile>#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nPanel widget for KosDWM PyQt5 version\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom PyQt5.QtWidgets import (\n    QWidget, QHBoxLayout, QVBoxLayout, QLabel, QPushButton, \n    QComboBox, QFrame, QMenu, QAction, QButtonGroup\n)\nfrom PyQt5.QtCore import Qt, QTimer\nfrom PyQt5.QtGui import QFont\n\nfrom datetime import datetime\n\n\nclass Panel(QFrame):\n    \"\"\"\n    Top panel with gadgets, menus, clock, and desktop switcher\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, parent=None):\n        super().__init__(parent)\n        # Height is controlled by parent window (30px)\n        self.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QFrame {\n                background-color: #333333;\n                border: none;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 8px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #555555;\n            }\n            QLabel {\n                color: white;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 5px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n                min-width: 120px;\n                max-width: 200px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::drop-down {\n                border: none;\n                width: 20px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::down-arrow {\n                image: none;\n                border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-top: 6px solid white;\n                margin-right: 5px;\n            }\n            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #666666;\n                selection-background-color: #666666;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Setup desktop manager\n        from src.desktop_manager_pyqt5 import DesktopManager\n        self.desktop_manager = DesktopManager(self)\n        self.desktop_manager.desktop_changed.connect(self.on_desktop_changed)\n        \n        # Setup menu manager\n        from src.menus_pyqt5 import MenuManager\n        self.menu_manager = MenuManager(self)\n        \n        # Setup window manager\n        from src.window_manager_pyqt5 import WindowManager\n        self.window_manager = WindowManager()\n        \n        self.setup_ui()\n        \n        # Timer for clock updates\n        self.timer = QTimer()\n        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.update_time)\n        self.timer.start(1000)\n        \n        # Timer for window list updates\n        self.window_timer = QTimer()\n        self.window_timer.timeout.connect(self.update_window_list)\n        self.window_timer.start(2000)  # Update every 2 seconds\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the panel UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(5, 2, 5, 2)\n        layout.setSpacing(5)\n        \n        # Left side: Menus button with dynamic menu\n        self.menus_button = QPushButton(\"\u2630\")\n        self.menus_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.menus_button.setMenu(self.build_menus_menu())\n        layout.addWidget(self.menus_button)\n        \n        # Window switcher dropdown\n        self.window_combo = QComboBox()\n        self.window_combo.setPlaceholderText(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\")\n        self.window_combo.setEnabled(self.window_manager.is_available())\n        self.window_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.on_window_selected)\n        layout.addWidget(self.window_combo)\n        \n        # Desktop buttons\n        self.desktop_group = QButtonGroup(self)\n        self.desktop_buttons = []\n        for i in range(4):\n            btn = QPushButton(str(i + 1))\n            btn.setFixedWidth(25)\n            btn.setFixedHeight(22)\n            btn.setCheckable(True)\n            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, d=i: self.switch_desktop(d))\n            self.desktop_group.addButton(btn)\n            self.desktop_buttons.append(btn)\n            layout.addWidget(btn)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Load gadgets\n        self.load_gadgets()\n        \n        # Set current desktop\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        \n        # Initial window list population\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_window_list(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the window switcher dropdown with current windows\"\"\"\n        if not self.window_manager.is_available():\n            self.window_combo.setEnabled(False)\n            return\n        \n        self.window_combo.setEnabled(True)\n        \n        # Get current selection before clearing\n        current_id = None\n        current_index = self.window_combo.currentIndex()\n        if current_index > 0:  # 0 is placeholder\n            current_data = self.window_combo.itemData(current_index)\n            if current_data:\n                current_id = current_data.get('id')\n        \n        # Block signals while updating\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(True)\n        self.window_combo.clear()\n        \n        # Add placeholder with icon\n        self.window_combo.addItem(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\", None)\n        \n        # Get windows and add to dropdown\n        windows = self.window_manager.get_windows()\n        selected_index = 0\n        \n        for i, window in enumerate(windows):\n            # Truncate long titles\n            title = window['title']\n            display_title = title[:32] + \"...\" if len(title) > 35 else title\n            \n            # Add desktop number prefix if not on current desktop\n            display_text = display_title\n            desktop_prefix = \"\"\n            if window['desktop'] != -1:  # -1 means sticky/all desktops\n                current_desktop = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n                if window['desktop'] != current_desktop:\n                    desktop_prefix = f\"[{window['desktop']+1}] \"\n                    display_text = f\"{desktop_prefix}{display_title}\"\n            \n            index = self.window_combo.count()\n            self.window_combo.addItem(display_text, window)\n            \n            # Set tooltip with full info\n            tooltip = f\"{desktop_prefix}{window['name']}\\nDesktop: {window['desktop']+1 if window['desktop'] >= 0 else 'All'}\"\n            self.window_combo.setItemData(index, tooltip, Qt.ToolTipRole)\n            \n            # Restore selection if this window was selected\n            if current_id and window['id'] == current_id:\n                selected_index = index\n        \n        # Restore selection\n        self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(selected_index)\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(False)\n    \n    def on_window_selected(self, index):\n        \"\"\"Handle window selection from dropdown\"\"\"\n        if index <= 0:  # Placeholder selected\n            return\n        \n        window = self.window_combo.itemData(index)\n        if window and 'id' in window:\n            # Visual feedback - briefly highlight the combo\n            self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QComboBox {\n                    background-color: #666666;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 2px 5px;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                    min-width: 120px;\n                    max-width: 200px;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n            \n            # Activate the window\n            success = self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            \n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n            \n            # Reset style after a short delay\n            from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer\n            QTimer.singleShot(200, self._reset_window_combo_style)\n    \n    def _reset_window_combo_style(self):\n        \"\"\"Reset window combo to normal style\"\"\"\n        self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 5px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n                min-width: 120px;\n                max-width: 200px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::drop-down {\n                border: none;\n                width: 20px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::down-arrow {\n                image: none;\n                border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-top: 6px solid white;\n                margin-right: 5px;\n            }\n            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #666666;\n                selection-background-color: #666666;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n    \n    def load_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Load gadgets into the panel\"\"\"\n        from src.gadgets_pyqt5 import GadgetManager\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n        # Update window list to show new desktop's windows\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Load dynamic menus\n        for menu_data in self.menu_manager.load_menus():\n            if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"branch\" and menu_data.get(\"items\"):\n                # Create submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                for item in menu_data[\"items\"]:\n                    if item[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, p=item[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                        )\n                    elif item[\"type\"] == \"leaf\":\n                        action = submenu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, m=item: self.menu_manager._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                        )\n            else:\n                # <!-- {"role": "assistant", "content": "<WriteFile>\n<fileName>src/gadget_config_pyqt5.py</fileName>\n<contentOfFile>#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nGadget Configuration Dialog for KosDWM PyQt5\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom PyQt5.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QHBoxLayout, QLabel, QCheckBox\nfrom PyQt5.QtWidgets import QPushButton, QScrollArea, QWidget, QFrame, QMessageBox\nfrom PyQt5.QtCore import Qt\n\n\nclass GadgetConfigDialog(QDialog):\n    \"\"\"\n    Configuration dialog for enabling/disabling gadgets\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, gadget_manager, parent=None):\n        super().__init__(parent)\n        self.gadget_manager = gadget_manager\n        self.checkboxes = {}\n        \n        self.setWindowTitle(\"Gadget Configuration\")\n        self.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 500)\n        \n        # Light theme styling - much more visible\n        self.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QDialog {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n            }\n            QLabel {\n                color: #333333;\n            }\n            QLabel#header {\n                font-size: 18px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n                color: #333333;\n            }\n            QLabel#description {\n                color: #666666;\n                font-size: 13px;\n            }\n            QCheckBox {\n                color: #333333;\n                spacing: 8px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n            }\n            QCheckBox::indicator {\n                width: 18px;\n                height: 18px;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 10px 20px;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #357abd;\n            }\n            QPushButton:pressed {\n                background-color: #2a6299;\n            }\n            QScrollArea {\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                background-color: white;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n            }\n            QFrame#gadgetItem {\n                background-color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #dddddd;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                padding: 10px;\n            }\n            QFrame#gadgetItem:hover {\n                background-color: #f0f8ff;\n                border-color: #4a90d9;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        self.setup_ui()\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the dialog UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setSpacing(15)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)\n        \n        # Header\n        header = QLabel(\"\u2699\ufe0f Gadget Configuration\")\n        header.setObjectName(\"header\")\n        layout.addWidget(header)\n        \n        # Description\n        desc = QLabel(\"Enable or disable gadgets to customize your panel\")\n        desc.setObjectName(\"description\")\n        desc.setWordWrap(True)\n        layout.addWidget(desc)\n        \n        # Scroll area for gadgets\n        scroll = QScrollArea()\n        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)\n        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)\n        \n        # Container for gadgets\n        container = QWidget()\n        container_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)\n        container_layout.setSpacing(10)\n        container_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignTop)\n        \n        # Get available gadgets\n        available = self.gadget_manager.get_available_gadgets()\n        \n        if not available:\n            label = QLabel(\"No gadgets available\")\n            label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)\n            label.setStyleSheet(\"color: gray; font-style: italic; padding: 50px;\")\n            container_layout.addWidget(label)\n        else:\n            for gadget_name in available:\n                info = self.gadget_manager.get_gadget_info(gadget_name)\n                if info:\n                    self._create_gadget_item(container_layout, info)\n        \n        container_layout.addStretch()\n        scroll.setWidget(container)\n        layout.addWidget(scroll)\n        \n        # Buttons\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        \n        reload_btn = QPushButton(\"\ud83d\udd04 Reload\")\n        reload_btn.setToolTip(\"Reload gadgets from disk\")\n        reload_btn.clicked.connect(self.reload_gadgets)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(reload_btn)\n        \n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        cancel_btn = QPushButton(\"Cancel\")\n        cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(cancel_btn)\n        \n        save_btn = QPushButton(\"\ud83d\udcbe Save\")\n        save_btn.setDefault(True)\n        save_btn.clicked.connect(self.save_config)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(save_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)\n    \n    def _create_gadget_item(self, layout, info):\n        \"\"\"Create a widget for a single gadget\"\"\"\n        frame = QFrame()\n        frame.setObjectName(\"gadgetItem\")\n        frame_layout = QHBoxLayout(frame)\n        frame_layout.setSpacing(10)\n        \n        # Checkbox for enabling\n        checkbox = QCheckBox(f\"{info['icon']} {info['name']}\")\n        checkbox.setChecked(info['enabled'])\n        checkbox.setToolTip(info['description'])\n        self.checkboxes[info['name']] = checkbox\n        frame_layout.addWidget(checkbox)\n        \n        frame_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Source label\n        source = info.get('source', 'unknown')\n        source_label = QLabel(f\"[{source}]\")\n        source_label.setStyleSheet(\"color: #888888; font-size: 11px;\")\n        frame_layout.addWidget(source_label)\n        \n        layout.addWidget(frame)\n        \n        # Description below\n        if info.get('description'):\n            desc = QLabel(info['description'])\n            desc.setObjectName(\"description\")\n            desc.setWordWrap(True)\n            desc.setIndent(30)  # Align with checkbox\n            layout.addWidget(desc)\n    \n    def save_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Save the configuration\"\"\"\n        for gadget_name, checkbox in self.checkboxes.items():\n            if checkbox.isChecked():\n                self.gadget_manager.enable_gadget(gadget_name)\n            else:\n                self.gadget_manager.disable_gadget(gadget_name)\n        \n        self.accept()\n    \n    def reload_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Reload gadgets from disk\"\"\"\n        reply = QMessageBox.question(\n            self,\n            \"Reload Gadgets\",\n            \"This will reload all gadgets from disk. Continue?\",\n            QMessageBox.Yes | QMessageBox.No\n        )\n        \n        if reply == QMessageBox.Yes:\n            self.gadget_manager.reload_gadgets()\n            # Refresh UI\n            self.close()\n            dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self.parent())\n            dialog.exec_()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 164, "timestamp": 1784844140.015435, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 48049, "response_tokens": 1439} -->

Desktop buttons\n        self.desktop_group = QButtonGroup(self)\n        self.desktop_buttons = []\n        for i in range(4):\n            btn = QPushButton(str(i + 1))\n            btn.setFixedWidth(25)\n            btn.setFixedHeight(22)\n            btn.setCheckable(True)\n            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, d=i: self.switch_desktop(d))\n            self.desktop_group.addButton(btn)\n            self.desktop_buttons.append(btn)\n            layout.addWidget(btn)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Placeholder selected\n            return\n        \n        window = self.window_combo.itemData(index)\n        if window and 'id' in window:\n            # Visual feedback - briefly highlight the combo\n            self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QComboBox {\n                    background-color: #666666;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 2px 5px;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                    min-width: 120px;\n                    max-width: 200px;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n            \n            # Activate the window\n            success = self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            \n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n            \n            # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n        # Light theme for menu - much more visible\n        menu.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QMenu {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n                color: #333333;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                padding: 5px;\n            }\n            QMenu::item {\n                padding: 8px 25px;\n                border-radius: 3px;\n                color: #333333;\n            }\n            QMenu::item:selected {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n            }\n            QMenu::item:hover {\n                background-color: #5aa0e9;\n                color: white;\n            }\n            QMenu::separator {\n                height: 1px;\n                background-color: #cccccc;\n                margin: 5px 0px;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Single item\n                action = menu.addAction(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                if menu_data[\"type\"] == \"script\":\n                    if \"command\" in menu_data:\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, cmd=menu_data[\"command\"]: self._run_command(cmd)\n                        )\n                    elif \"path\" in menu_data:\n                        action.triggered.connect(\n                            lambda checked, p=menu_data[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                        )\n        \n        menu.addSeparator()\n        menu.addAction(\"Exit\", self.window().close)\n        \n        return menu\n    \n    def _run_command(self, command):\n        \"\"\"Run a shell command\"\"\"\n        import subprocess\n        try:\n            subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running command: {e}\")\n    \n    def open_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Open gadget configuration\"\"\"\n        from src.gadget_config_pyqt5 import GadgetConfigDialog\n        \n        dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self)\n        if dialog.exec_():\n            self.load_gadgets()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 169, "timestamp": 1784844423.7725585, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 64494, "response_tokens": 3128} -->

Restore selection if this window was selected\n            if current_id and window['id'] == current_id:\n                selected_index = index\n        \n        # Restore selection\n        self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(selected_index)\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(False)\n    \n    def on_window_selected(self, index):\n        \"\"\"Handle window selection from dropdown\"\"\"\n        if index <= 0:  # Placeholder selected\n            return\n        \n        window = self.window_combo.itemData(index)\n        if window and 'id' in window:\n            # Visual feedback - briefly highlight the combo\n            self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QComboBox {\n                    background-color: #666666;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 2px 5px;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                    min-width: 120px;\n                    max-width: 200px;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n            \n            # Activate the window\n            success = self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            \n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n            \n            # Reset style after a short delay\n            from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer\n            QTimer.singleShot(200, self._reset_window_combo_style)\n    \n    def _reset_window_combo_style(self):\n        \"\"\"Reset window combo to normal style\"\"\"\n        self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 5px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n                min-width: 120px;\n                max-width: 200px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::drop-down {\n                border: none;\n                width: 20px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::down-arrow {\n                image: none;\n                border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-top: 6px solid white;\n                margin-right: 5px;\n            }\n            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #666666;\n                selection-background-color: #666666;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n    \n    def load_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Load gadgets into the panel\"\"\"\n        from src.gadgets_pyqt5 import GadgetManager\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n        # Update window list to show new desktop's windows\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Light theme for menu - much more visible\n        menu.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QMenu {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n                color: #333333;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                padding: 5px;\n            }\n            QMenu::item {\n                padding: 8px 25px;\n                border-radius: 3px;\n                color: #333333;\n            }\n            QMenu::item:selected {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n            }\n            QMenu::item:hover {\n                background-color: #5aa0e9;\n                color: white;\n            }\n            QMenu::separator {\n                height: 1px;\n                background-color: #cccccc;\n                margin: 5px 0px;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Load dynamic menus\n        for menu_data in self.menu_manager.load_menus():\n            if menu_data.get(\"type\") == \"branch\" and menu_data.get(\"items\"):\n                # Create submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, menu_data[\"items\"], menu_data.get(\"path\"))\n            elif menu_data.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                action = menu.addAction(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                if \"command\" in menu_data:\n                    action.triggered.connect(\n                        lambda checked, cmd=menu_data[\"command\"]: self._run_command(cmd)\n                    )\n                elif \"path\" in menu_data:\n                    action.triggered.connect(\n                        lambda checked, p=menu_data[\"path\"]: self.menu_manager._run_script(p)\n                    )\n            elif menu_data.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                action = menu.addAction(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=menu_data: self.menu_manager._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n        \n        menu.addSeparator()\n        menu.addAction(\"Exit\", self.window().close)\n        \n        return menu\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items, base_path=None):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items recursively\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Add path to item if not present\n                if base_path and \"path\" not in item:\n                    item[\"path\"] = base_path\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self.menu_manager._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n    \n    def _run_command(self, command):\n        \"\"\"Run a shell command\"\"\"\n        import subprocess\n        try:\n            subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True)\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running command: {e}\")\n    \n    def open_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Open gadget configuration\"\"\"\n        from src.gadget_config_pyqt5 import GadgetConfigDialog\n        \n        dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self)\n        if dialog.exec_():\n            self.load_gadgets()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 171, "timestamp": 1784844628.575807, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 75065, "response_tokens": 3289} -->

Submenu - recurse\n                submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                if submenu:\n                    submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                    submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                    items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py':\n                # Check for windowScript (dynamic command)\n        window_script = config.get(\"windowScript\")\n        if window_script:\n            self._open_script_window(config, path)\n            return\n        \n        # Static content window\n        self._open_content_window(config, path)\n    \n    def _open_script_window(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Open window that runs a command in loop\"\"\"\n        from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QTextEdit, QPushButton, QHBoxLayout, QTimer\n        \n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(config.get(\"title\", \"Command Output\"))\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 800, 600)\n        \n        # Light theme styling\n        dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QDialog {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n            }\n            QTextEdit {\n                background-color: black;\n                color: #00ff00;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                padding: 10px;\n                font-family: monospace;\n                font-size: 12px;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 10px 20px;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #357abd;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(15)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)\n        \n        # Convert to milliseconds\n            interval = loop * 1000  # default seconds\n            if looptype == \"minute\":\n                interval = loop * 60 * 1000\n            elif looptype == \"millisecond\":\n                interval = loop\n            \n            timer.start(interval)\n        \n        # Button row\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Refresh button\n        refresh_btn = QPushButton(\"Refresh\")\n        refresh_btn.clicked.connect(run_command)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(refresh_btn)\n        \n        # Content text area\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        \n        # Load content from file\n        content_file = config.get(\"windowContent\", \"\")\n        if content_file:\n            full_path = path / content_file\n            if full_path.exists():\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path) as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n            else:\n                text.setText(f\"Content file not found: {content_file}\\nPath: {full_path}\")\n        else:\n            text.setText(\"No windowContent configured in config.json\")\n        \n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button row\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # OK button\n        ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n        ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)\n        \n        dialog.exec_()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=item[\"path\"]: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 180, "timestamp": 1784845163.5227075, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 91257, "response_tokens": 2122} -->

Scan each directory in Menus as a top-level menu\n        for menu_dir in sorted(self.menus_dir.iterdir()):\n            if menu_dir.is_dir():\n                menu_data = self._scan_menu_directory(menu_dir)\n                if menu_data:\n                    menus.append(menu_data)\n        \n        return menus\n    \n    def _scan_menu_directory(self, directory):\n        \"\"\"Recursively scan a menu directory\"\"\"\n        items = []\n        \n        for item_path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):\n            if item_path.is_dir():\n                # Submenu - recurse\n                submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                if submenu:\n                    submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                    submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                    items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py':\n                # Python script - but only if no config.json in parent\n                continue\n            elif item_path.name == \"config.json\":\n                # Config file for leaf menu - handled below\n                continue\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a Python script\"\"\"\n        try:\n            subprocess.Popen(\n                [\"python\", str(script_path)],\n                cwd=str(Path(script_path).parent)\n            )\n        except Exception as e:\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _run_command(self, command):\n        \"\"\"Run a shell command\"\"\"\n        try:\n            subprocess.Popen(command, shell=True)\n        except Exception as e:\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run command:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Open a leaf menu - handle both ok.py scripts and config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\", self.menus_dir)\n        \n        # Check for ok.py first (original behavior)\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            self._run_ok_script(ok_script, config)\n            return\n        \n        # Check for windowScript in config (dynamic command)\n        window_script = config.get(\"windowScript\")\n        if window_script:\n            self._open_script_window(config, path)\n            return\n        \n        # Static content window\n        self._open_content_window(config, path)\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, script_path, config):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py with run(window) function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            import importlib.util\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            \n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Create a dummy window object with destroy method\n                class DummyWindow:\n                    def destroy(self):\n                        pass\n                \n                window = DummyWindow()\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function found in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_script_window(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Open window that runs a command in loop\"\"\"\n        from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QTextEdit, QPushButton, QHBoxLayout, QTimer\n        \n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(config.get(\"title\", \"Command Output\"))\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 800, 600)\n        \n        # Light theme styling\n        dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QDialog {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n            }\n            QTextEdit {\n                background-color: black;\n                color: #00ff00;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                padding: 10px;\n                font-family: monospace;\n                font-size: 12px;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 10px 20px;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #357abd;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(15)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)\n        \n        # Content text area\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        def run_command():\n            try:\n                result = subprocess.run(\n                    config[\"windowScript\"],\n                    shell=True,\n                    capture_output=True,\n                    text=True,\n                    timeout=30\n                )\n                text.setText(result.stdout)\n                if result.stderr:\n                    text.append(f\"\\n\\nSTDERR:\\n{result.stderr}\")\n            except Exception as e:\n                text.setText(f\"Error running command: {e}\")\n        \n        # Run immediately\n        run_command()\n        \n        # Set up timer for looping\n        loop = config.get(\"loop\", 0)\n        looptype = config.get(\"looptype\", \"second\")\n        if loop > 0:\n            timer = QTimer(dialog)\n            timer.timeout.connect(run_command)\n            \n            # Convert to milliseconds\n            interval = loop * 1000  # default seconds\n            if looptype == \"minute\":\n                interval = loop * 60 * 1000\n            elif looptype == \"millisecond\":\n                interval = loop\n            \n            timer.start(interval)\n        \n        # Button row\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Refresh button\n        refresh_btn = QPushButton(\"Refresh\")\n        refresh_btn.clicked.connect(run_command)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(refresh_btn)\n        \n        # OK button\n        ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n        ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)\n        \n        dialog.exec_()\n    \n    def _open_content_window(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Open window with static content\"\"\"\n        from PyQt5.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QTextEdit, QPushButton, QHBoxLayout\n        \n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(config.get(\"title\", \"Menu\"))\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 700, 500)\n        \n        # Light theme styling\n        dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QDialog {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n            }\n            QTextEdit {\n                background-color: white;\n                color: #333333;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                padding: 10px;\n                font-family: monospace;\n                font-size: 12px;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 10px 20px;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #357abd;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(15)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)\n        \n        # Content text area\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        \n        # Load content from file\n        content_file = config.get(\"windowContent\", \"\")\n        if content_file:\n            full_path = path / content_file\n            if full_path.exists():\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path) as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n            else:\n                text.setText(f\"Content file not found: {content_file}\\nPath: {full_path}\")\n        else:\n            text.setText(\"No windowContent configured in config.json\")\n        \n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button row\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # OK button\n        ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n        ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)\n        \n        dialog.exec_()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=item[\"path\"]: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 181, "timestamp": 1784845276.574697, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 95673, "response_tokens": 2348} -->
