Check if this subfolder has config.json (leaf menu)\n                config_file = item_path / \"config.json\"\n                if config_file.exists():\n                    # Leaf menu - add as clickable item\n                    try:\n                        with open(config_file) as f:\n                            config = json.load(f)\n                        items.append({\n                            \"name\": item_path.name,\n                            \"type\": \"leaf\",\n                            \"config\": config,\n                            \"path\": item_path\n                        })\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Error loading config {config_file}: {e}\")\n                else:\n                    # Branch menu - recurse\n                    submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                    if submenu:\n                        submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                        submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                        items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py' and item_path.name != '__init__.py':\n                # Python script - add as runnable script\n                items.append({\n                    \"name\": item_path.stem,\n                    \"type\": \"script\",\n                    \"path\": str(item_path)\n                })\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a menu script with run() function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"menu_script\", script_path)\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Pass parent window to script\n                module.run(self.parent)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running script {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Show window with content from folder's config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\")\n        \n        if not path:\n            return\n        \n        # Get settings from config\n        content_file = config.get('windowContent', '')\n        script_cmd = config.get('windowScript', '')\n        loop_interval = config.get('loop', 0)\n        looptype = config.get('looptype', 'second')\n        title = config.get('title', path.name)\n        \n        # Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark terminal-like theme for script output, light for content\n        if script_cmd:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: none;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #555555; }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #f5f5f5; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: white; \n                    color: #333333; \n                    border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a90d9;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #357abd; }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Check for ok.py\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._run_ok_script(dialog, ok_script))\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        else:\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_frame)\n        \n        # Handle script command (looping)\n        if script_cmd:\n            interval_ms = loop_interval * 1000 if looptype == 'second' else loop_interval\n            \n            def update_output():\n                try:\n                    result = subprocess.run(\n                        script_cmd, \n                        shell=True, \n                        capture_output=True, \n                        text=True, \n                        timeout=10\n                    )\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(str(e))\n                \n                # Schedule next update if window still exists\n                if dialog.isVisible() and loop_interval > 0:\n                    QTimer.singleShot(interval_ms, update_output)\n            \n            # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.exec_()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Python script - run with run()\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                script_path = item[\"path\"]\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=script_path: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                # Height is controlled by parent window (30px)\n        self.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QFrame {\n                background-color: #333333;\n                border: none;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 8px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #555555;\n            }\n            QLabel {\n                color: white;\n                font-size: 11px;\n            }\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 5px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n                min-width: 120px;\n                max-width: 200px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::drop-down {\n                border: none;\n                width: 20px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::down-arrow {\n                image: none;\n                border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-top: 6px solid white;\n                margin-right: 5px;\n            }\n            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #666666;\n                selection-background-color: #666666;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Setup desktop manager\n        from src.desktop_manager_pyqt5 import DesktopManager\n        self.desktop_manager = DesktopManager(self)\n        self.desktop_manager.desktop_changed.connect(self.on_desktop_changed)\n        \n        # Setup menu manager\n        from src.menus_pyqt5 import MenuManager\n        self.menu_manager = MenuManager(self)\n        \n        # Setup window manager\n        from src.window_manager_pyqt5 import WindowManager\n        self.window_manager = WindowManager()\n        \n        self.setup_ui()\n        \n        # Timer for clock updates\n        self.timer = QTimer()\n        self.timer.timeout.connect(self.update_time)\n        self.timer.start(1000)\n        \n        # Timer for window list updates\n        self.window_timer = QTimer()\n        self.window_timer.timeout.connect(self.update_window_list)\n        self.window_timer.start(2000)  # Update every 2 seconds\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the panel UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(5, 2, 5, 2)\n        layout.setSpacing(5)\n        \n        # Left side: Menus button with dynamic menu\n        self.menus_button = QPushButton(\"\u2630\")\n        self.menus_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.menus_button.setMenu(self.build_menus_menu())\n        layout.addWidget(self.menus_button)\n        \n        # Window switcher dropdown\n        self.window_combo = QComboBox()\n        self.window_combo.setPlaceholderText(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\")\n        self.window_combo.setEnabled(self.window_manager.is_available())\n        self.window_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self.on_window_selected)\n        layout.addWidget(self.window_combo)\n        \n        # Desktop buttons\n        self.desktop_group = QButtonGroup(self)\n        self.desktop_buttons = []\n        for i in range(4):\n            btn = QPushButton(str(i + 1))\n            btn.setFixedWidth(25)\n            btn.setFixedHeight(22)\n            btn.setCheckable(True)\n            btn.clicked.connect(lambda checked, d=i: self.switch_desktop(d))\n            self.desktop_group.addButton(btn)\n            self.desktop_buttons.append(btn)\n            layout.addWidget(btn)\n        \n        # Middle: Gadgets frame\n        self.gadgets_frame = QFrame()\n        self.gadgets_frame.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: transparent;\")\n        self.gadgets_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.gadgets_frame)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)\n        self.gadgets_layout.setSpacing(5)\n        layout.addWidget(self.gadgets_frame)\n        \n        layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Clock\n        self.time_label = QLabel(\"00:00\")\n        self.time_label.setFont(QFont(\"Arial\", 10, QFont.Bold))\n        layout.addWidget(self.time_label)\n        \n        # Config button\n        self.config_button = QPushButton(\"\u2699\")\n        self.config_button.setFixedWidth(30)\n        self.config_button.setFixedHeight(22)\n        self.config_button.clicked.connect(self.open_config)\n        layout.addWidget(self.config_button)\n        \n        # Load gadgets\n        self.load_gadgets()\n        \n        # Set current desktop\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        \n        # Initial window list population\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_window_list(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the window switcher dropdown with current windows\"\"\"\n        if not self.window_manager.is_available():\n            self.window_combo.setEnabled(False)\n            return\n        \n        self.window_combo.setEnabled(True)\n        \n        # Get current selection before clearing\n        current_id = None\n        current_index = self.window_combo.currentIndex()\n        if current_index > 0:  # 0 is placeholder\n            current_data = self.window_combo.itemData(current_index)\n            if current_data:\n                current_id = current_data.get('id')\n        \n        # Block signals while updating\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(True)\n        self.window_combo.clear()\n        \n        # Add placeholder with icon\n        self.window_combo.addItem(\"\ud83e\ude9f Windows\", None)\n        \n        # Get windows and add to dropdown\n        windows = self.window_manager.get_windows()\n        selected_index = 0\n        \n        for i, window in enumerate(windows):\n            # Truncate long titles\n            title = window['title']\n            display_title = title[:32] + \"...\" if len(title) > 35 else title\n            \n            # Add desktop number prefix if not on current desktop\n            display_text = display_title\n            desktop_prefix = \"\"\n            if window['desktop'] != -1:  # -1 means sticky/all desktops\n                current_desktop = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n                if window['desktop'] != current_desktop:\n                    desktop_prefix = f\"[{window['desktop']+1}] \"\n                    display_text = f\"{desktop_prefix}{display_title}\"\n            \n            index = self.window_combo.count()\n            self.window_combo.addItem(display_text, window)\n            \n            # Set tooltip with full info\n            tooltip = f\"{desktop_prefix}{window['name']}\\nDesktop: {window['desktop']+1 if window['desktop'] >= 0 else 'All'}\"\n            self.window_combo.setItemData(index, tooltip, Qt.ToolTipRole)\n            \n            # Restore selection if this window was selected\n            if current_id and window['id'] == current_id:\n                selected_index = index\n        \n        # Restore selection\n        self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(selected_index)\n        self.window_combo.blockSignals(False)\n    \n    def on_window_selected(self, index):\n        \"\"\"Handle window selection from dropdown\"\"\"\n        if index <= 0:  # Placeholder selected\n            return\n        \n        window = self.window_combo.itemData(index)\n        if window and 'id' in window:\n            # Visual feedback - briefly highlight the combo\n            self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QComboBox {\n                    background-color: #666666;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 2px 5px;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                    min-width: 120px;\n                    max-width: 200px;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n            \n            # Activate the window\n            success = self.window_manager.activate_window(window['id'])\n            \n            # Reset to placeholder after activation\n            self.window_combo.setCurrentIndex(0)\n            \n            # Reset style after a short delay\n            from PyQt5.QtCore import QTimer\n            QTimer.singleShot(200, self._reset_window_combo_style)\n    \n    def _reset_window_combo_style(self):\n        \"\"\"Reset window combo to normal style\"\"\"\n        self.window_combo.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QComboBox {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: none;\n                padding: 2px 5px;\n                font-size: 11px;\n                min-width: 120px;\n                max-width: 200px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::drop-down {\n                border: none;\n                width: 20px;\n            }\n            QComboBox::down-arrow {\n                image: none;\n                border-left: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-right: 4px solid transparent;\n                border-top: 6px solid white;\n                margin-right: 5px;\n            }\n            QComboBox QAbstractItemView {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: white;\n                border: 1px solid #666666;\n                selection-background-color: #666666;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n    \n    def load_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Load gadgets into the panel\"\"\"\n        from src.gadgets_pyqt5 import GadgetManager\n        \n        # Clear existing gadgets\n        while self.gadgets_layout.count():\n            item = self.gadgets_layout.takeAt(0)\n            if item.widget():\n                item.widget().deleteLater()\n        \n        # Create gadget manager\n        self.gadget_manager = GadgetManager()\n        \n        # Add enabled gadgets\n        for gadget in self.gadget_manager.get_enabled_gadgets():\n            btn = QPushButton(gadget.get_icon())\n            btn.setFixedSize(40, 22)\n            btn.setToolTip(gadget.get_tooltip())\n            # Store gadget reference on button to avoid lambda capture issues\n            btn._gadget = gadget\n            btn.clicked.connect(self._on_gadget_clicked)\n            self.gadgets_layout.addWidget(btn)\n    \n    def _on_gadget_clicked(self):\n        \"\"\"Handle gadget button click\"\"\"\n        btn = self.sender()\n        if btn and hasattr(btn, '_gadget'):\n            try:\n                btn._gadget.on_click()\n            except Exception as e:\n                print(f\"Error in gadget click: {e}\")\n                import traceback\n                traceback.print_exc()\n    \n    def update_time(self):\n        \"\"\"Update the clock\"\"\"\n        current = datetime.now().strftime(\"%H:%M\")\n        self.time_label.setText(current)\n    \n    def switch_desktop(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Switch to specified desktop\"\"\"\n        self.desktop_manager.switch_to_desktop(desktop_id)\n        # Update window list to show new desktop's windows\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def on_desktop_changed(self, desktop_id):\n        \"\"\"Handle desktop change\"\"\"\n        self.update_desktop_buttons()\n        self.update_window_list()\n    \n    def update_desktop_buttons(self):\n        \"\"\"Update desktop button states\"\"\"\n        current = self.desktop_manager.current_desktop\n        for i, btn in enumerate(self.desktop_buttons):\n            btn.setChecked(i == current)\n            if i == current:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #666666; font-weight: bold;\")\n            else:\n                btn.setStyleSheet(\"background-color: #4a4a4a;\")\n    \n    def build_menus_menu(self):\n        \"\"\"Build the dynamic menus\"\"\"\n        menu = QMenu(self)\n        \n        # Light theme for menu\n        menu.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QMenu {\n                background-color: #f5f5f5;\n                color: #333333;\n                border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                padding: 5px;\n            }\n            QMenu::item {\n                padding: 8px 25px;\n                border-radius: 3px;\n                color: #333333;\n            }\n            QMenu::item:selected {\n                background-color: #4a90d9;\n                color: white;\n            }\n            QMenu::separator {\n                height: 1px;\n                background-color: #cccccc;\n                margin: 5px 0px;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        # Load dynamic menus from directory structure\n        for menu_data in self.menu_manager.load_menus():\n            if menu_data.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Create top-level submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(menu_data[\"name\"])\n                self.menu_manager._populate_menu(submenu, menu_data.get(\"items\", []))\n        \n        menu.addSeparator()\n        menu.addAction(\"Exit\", self.window().close)\n        \n        return menu\n    \n    def open_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Open gadget configuration\"\"\"\n        from src.gadget_config_pyqt5 import GadgetConfigDialog\n        \n        dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self)\n        if dialog.exec_():\n            self.load_gadgets()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 184, "timestamp": 1784845536.0360572, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 106745, "response_tokens": 2815} -->

<!-- {"role": "assistant", "content": "<WriteFile>\n<fileName>src/menus_pyqt5.py</fileName>\n<contentOfFile>#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"\nMenu system for KosDWM PyQt5\n\nAuto-generates menus from directory structure in ~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/\nMatches original TkInter behavior exactly\n\"\"\"\n\nimport json\nimport subprocess\nimport os\nimport importlib.util\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom PyQt5.QtWidgets import QMenu, QAction, QMessageBox, QDialog, QVBoxLayout, QTextEdit, QPushButton, QHBoxLayout, QScrollArea, QWidget\nfrom PyQt5.QtCore import Qt, QTimer\n\n\nclass MenuManager:\n    \"\"\"\n    Manages dynamic menus for KosDWM - auto-generated from directory structure\n    \"\"\"\n    \n    def __init__(self, parent=None):\n        self.parent = parent\n        self.menus_dir = Path.home() / \".config\" / \"KosDWM\" / \"Menus\"\n    \n    def load_menus(self):\n        \"\"\"Load all menus from directory structure\"\"\"\n        menus = []\n        \n        if not self.menus_dir.exists():\n            return menus\n        \n        # Scan each directory in Menus as a top-level menu\n        for menu_dir in sorted(self.menus_dir.iterdir()):\n            if menu_dir.is_dir() and menu_dir.name != '__pycache__':\n                menu_data = self._scan_menu_directory(menu_dir)\n                if menu_data:\n                    menus.append(menu_data)\n        \n        return menus\n    \n    def _scan_menu_directory(self, directory):\n        \"\"\"Recursively scan a menu directory\"\"\"\n        items = []\n        \n        for item_path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):\n            if item_path.name == '__pycache__':\n                continue\n            \n            if item_path.is_dir():\n                # Check if this subfolder has config.json (leaf menu)\n                config_file = item_path / \"config.json\"\n                if config_file.exists():\n                    # Leaf menu - add as clickable item\n                    try:\n                        with open(config_file) as f:\n                            config = json.load(f)\n                        items.append({\n                            \"name\": item_path.name,\n                            \"type\": \"leaf\",\n                            \"config\": config,\n                            \"path\": item_path\n                        })\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Error loading config {config_file}: {e}\")\n                else:\n                    # Branch menu - recurse\n                    submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                    if submenu:\n                        submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                        submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                        items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py' and item_path.name != '__init__.py':\n                # Python script - add as runnable script\n                items.append({\n                    \"name\": item_path.stem,\n                    \"type\": \"script\",\n                    \"path\": str(item_path)\n                })\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a menu script with run() function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"menu_script\", script_path)\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Pass parent window to script\n                module.run(self.parent)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running script {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Show window with content from folder's config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\")\n        \n        if not path:\n            return\n        \n        # Use QTimer to open dialog after menu closes (prevents panel freeze)\n        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: self._show_leaf_dialog(config, path))\n    \n    def _show_leaf_dialog(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Actually show the leaf dialog\"\"\"\n        # Get settings from config\n        content_file = config.get('windowContent', '')\n        script_cmd = config.get('windowScript', '')\n        loop_interval = config.get('loop', 0)\n        looptype = config.get('looptype', 'second')\n        title = config.get('title', path.name)\n        \n        # Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark terminal-like theme for script output, light for content\n        if script_cmd:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: none;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #555555; }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #f5f5f5; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: white; \n                    color: #333333; \n                    border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a90d9;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #357abd; }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Check for ok.py\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._run_ok_script(dialog, ok_script))\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        else:\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_frame)\n        \n        # Handle script command (looping)\n        if script_cmd:\n            interval_ms = loop_interval * 1000 if looptype == 'second' else loop_interval\n            \n            def update_output():\n                try:\n                    result = subprocess.run(\n                        script_cmd, \n                        shell=True, \n                        capture_output=True, \n                        text=True, \n                        timeout=10\n                    )\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(str(e))\n                \n                # Schedule next update if window still exists and looping enabled\n                if dialog.isVisible() and loop_interval > 0:\n                    QTimer.singleShot(interval_ms, update_output)\n            \n            # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.exec_()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Create nested submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                # Python script - run with run()\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                script_path = item[\"path\"]\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=script_path: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                # Leaf menu - open content window\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 185, "timestamp": 1784845698.0613215, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 110750, "response_tokens": 2018} -->

Scan each directory in Menus as a top-level menu\n        for menu_dir in sorted(self.menus_dir.iterdir()):\n            if menu_dir.is_dir() and menu_dir.name != '__pycache__':\n                menu_data = self._scan_menu_directory(menu_dir)\n                if menu_data:\n                    menus.append(menu_data)\n        \n        return menus\n    \n    def _scan_menu_directory(self, directory):\n        \"\"\"Recursively scan a menu directory\"\"\"\n        items = []\n        \n        for item_path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):\n            if item_path.name == '__pycache__':\n                continue\n            \n            if item_path.is_dir():\n                # Check if this subfolder has config.json (leaf menu)\n                config_file = item_path / \"config.json\"\n                if config_file.exists():\n                    # Leaf menu - add as clickable item\n                    try:\n                        with open(config_file) as f:\n                            config = json.load(f)\n                        items.append({\n                            \"name\": item_path.name,\n                            \"type\": \"leaf\",\n                            \"config\": config,\n                            \"path\": item_path\n                        })\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Error loading config {config_file}: {e}\")\n                else:\n                    # Branch menu - recurse\n                    submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                    if submenu:\n                        submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                        submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                        items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py' and item_path.name != '__init__.py':\n                # Python script - add as runnable script\n                items.append({\n                    \"name\": item_path.stem,\n                    \"type\": \"script\",\n                    \"path\": str(item_path)\n                })\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a menu script with run() function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"menu_script\", script_path)\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Pass parent window to script\n                module.run(self.parent)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running script {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Show window with content from folder's config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\")\n        \n        if not path:\n            return\n        \n        # Use longer delay to let menu close first (prevents freeze)\n        self._pending_dialog = (config, path)\n        QTimer.singleShot(100, self._show_pending_dialog)\n    \n    def _show_pending_dialog(self):\n        \"\"\"Show the pending dialog\"\"\"\n        if self._pending_dialog:\n            config, path = self._pending_dialog\n            self._show_leaf_dialog(config, path)\n            self._pending_dialog = None\n    \n    def _show_leaf_dialog(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Actually show the leaf dialog\"\"\"\n        # Get settings from config\n        content_file = config.get('windowContent', '')\n        script_cmd = config.get('windowScript', '')\n        loop_interval = config.get('loop', 0)\n        looptype = config.get('looptype', 'second')\n        title = config.get('title', path.name)\n        \n        # Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark terminal-like theme for script output, light for content\n        if script_cmd:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: none;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #555555; }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #f5f5f5; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: white; \n                    color: #333333; \n                    border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a90d9;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #357abd; }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Check for ok.py\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._run_ok_script(dialog, ok_script))\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        else:\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_frame)\n        \n        # Handle script command (looping)\n        if script_cmd:\n            interval_ms = loop_interval * 1000 if looptype == 'second' else loop_interval\n            \n            def update_output():\n                try:\n                    result = subprocess.run(\n                        script_cmd, \n                        shell=True, \n                        capture_output=True, \n                        text=True, \n                        timeout=10\n                    )\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(str(e))\n                \n                # Schedule next update if window still exists and looping enabled\n                if dialog.isVisible() and loop_interval > 0:\n                    QTimer.singleShot(interval_ms, update_output)\n            \n            # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.show()\n        dialog.raise_()\n        dialog.activateWindow()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Create nested submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                # Python script - run with run()\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                script_path = item[\"path\"]\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=script_path: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                # Leaf menu - open content window\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 186, "timestamp": 1784845881.2868335, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 114173, "response_tokens": 2079} -->

Scan each directory in Menus as a top-level menu\n        for menu_dir in sorted(self.menus_dir.iterdir()):\n            if menu_dir.is_dir() and menu_dir.name != '__pycache__':\n                menu_data = self._scan_menu_directory(menu_dir)\n                if menu_data:\n                    menus.append(menu_data)\n        \n        return menus\n    \n    def _scan_menu_directory(self, directory):\n        \"\"\"Recursively scan a menu directory\"\"\"\n        items = []\n        \n        for item_path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):\n            if item_path.name == '__pycache__':\n                continue\n            \n            if item_path.is_dir():\n                # Check if this subfolder has config.json (leaf menu)\n                config_file = item_path / \"config.json\"\n                if config_file.exists():\n                    # Leaf menu - add as clickable item\n                    try:\n                        with open(config_file) as f:\n                            config = json.load(f)\n                        items.append({\n                            \"name\": item_path.name,\n                            \"type\": \"leaf\",\n                            \"config\": config,\n                            \"path\": item_path\n                        })\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Error loading config {config_file}: {e}\")\n                else:\n                    # Branch menu - recurse\n                    submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                    if submenu:\n                        submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                        submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                        items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py' and item_path.name != '__init__.py':\n                # Python script - add as runnable script\n                items.append({\n                    \"name\": item_path.stem,\n                    \"type\": \"script\",\n                    \"path\": str(item_path)\n                })\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a menu script with run() function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"menu_script\", script_path)\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Pass parent window to script\n                module.run(self.parent)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running script {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Show window with content from folder's config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\")\n        \n        if not path:\n            return\n        \n        # Use longer delay to let menu close first (prevents freeze)\n        self._pending_dialog = (config, path)\n        QTimer.singleShot(100, self._show_pending_dialog)\n    \n    def _show_pending_dialog(self):\n        \"\"\"Show the pending dialog\"\"\"\n        if self._pending_dialog:\n            config, path = self._pending_dialog\n            self._show_leaf_dialog(config, path)\n            self._pending_dialog = None\n    \n    def _show_leaf_dialog(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Actually show the leaf dialog\"\"\"\n        # Get settings from config\n        content_file = config.get('windowContent', '')\n        script_cmd = config.get('windowScript', '')\n        loop_interval = config.get('loop', 0)\n        looptype = config.get('looptype', 'second')\n        title = config.get('title', path.name)\n        \n        # Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark terminal-like theme for script output, light for content\n        if script_cmd:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: none;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #555555; }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #f5f5f5; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: white; \n                    color: #333333; \n                    border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a90d9;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #357abd; }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Check for ok.py\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._run_ok_script(dialog, ok_script))\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        else:\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_frame)\n        \n        # Handle script command (looping)\n        if script_cmd:\n            interval_ms = loop_interval * 1000 if looptype == 'second' else loop_interval\n            \n            def update_output():\n                try:\n                    result = subprocess.run(\n                        script_cmd, \n                        shell=True, \n                        capture_output=True, \n                        text=True, \n                        timeout=10\n                    )\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(str(e))\n                \n                # Schedule next update if window still exists and looping enabled\n                if dialog.isVisible() and loop_interval > 0:\n                    QTimer.singleShot(interval_ms, update_output)\n            \n            # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.show()\n        dialog.raise_()\n        dialog.activateWindow()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Create nested submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                # Python script - run with run()\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                script_path = item[\"path\"]\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=script_path: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                # Leaf menu - open content window\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 187, "timestamp": 1784845945.874877, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 117404, "response_tokens": 2078} -->

Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark terminal-like theme for script output, light for content\n        if script_cmd:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: none;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #555555; }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #f5f5f5; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: white; \n                    color: #333333; \n                    border: 1px solid #cccccc;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a90d9;\n                    color: white;\n                    border: none;\n                    padding: 8px 16px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover { background-color: #357abd; }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.show()\n        dialog.raise_()\n        dialog.activateWindow()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Now with PyQt5!\n\n## Features\n\n- **Dynamic Window Management** - Tiling window manager for X11\n- **PyQt5 Panel** - Modern Qt-based panel with gadgets and menus\n- **Auto-Generative Menus** - Dynamic menus from `~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/` directory structure\n  - Folders = submenus\n  - `config.json` = leaf menus with content windows\n  - `.py` scripts = runnable with `run()` function\n  - `windowScript` = looping command output (like `lsof`)\n- **Gadget System** - Pluggable Python gadgets for the panel\n- **Window Switcher** - Dropdown to switch between running windows (wmctrl)\n- **Notices & Reminders** - Built-in notification system with HTTP API\n- **Auto-Versioning** - Automatic version increment on commits\n\n## Quick Start\n\n```bash\n# Install PyQt5 version\npython install_kosdwm_pyqt5.py\n\n# Run\npython main_pyqt5.py\n```\n\n## Configuration\n\n### Panel Config (`~/.config/KosDWM/config.json`):\n```json\n{\n    \"active_button_bg\": \"#4a90d9\",\n    \"inactive_button_bg\": \"#606060\",\n    \"bar_height\": 30,\n    \"layout_mode\": \"comboboxes\"\n}\n```\n\n### Menu Structure (`~/.config/KosDWM/Menus/`):\n```\nMenus/\n\u251c\u2500\u2500 Home/\n\u2502   \u251c\u2500\u2500 About/              # Leaf menu (config.json + content.html)\n\u2502   \u2502   \u251c\u2500\u2500 config.json     # {\"title\": \"About\", \"windowContent\": \"content.html\"}\n\u2502   \u2502   \u251c\u2500\u2500 content.html    # Static content\n\u2502   \u2502   \u2514\u2500\u2500 ok.py           # Optional: run() function called on OK\n\u2502   \u2514\u2500\u2500 Test/               # Another leaf menu\n\u2502       \u251c\u2500\u2500 config.json     # {\"windowScript\": \"lsof -i\", \"loop\": 5}\n\u2502       \u2514\u2500\u2500 ok.py\n\u2514\u2500\u2500 Scripts/\n    \u2514\u2500\u2500 myscript.py         # Runnable script with run() function\n```\n\n### Gadget Config (`~/.config/KosDWM/gadgets.json`):\n```json\n{\n    \"enabled\": [\"hello_world\", \"test_gadget\", \"notices\"]\n}\n```\n\n## Documentation\n\n- [Notices API](NOTICES_API_DOCUMENTATION.md) - HTTP API for notices\n- [PyQt5 Readme](PYQT5_README.md) - PyQt5 specific documentation\n- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md) - Version history\n\n## License\n\nMIT License - Created with love by B.K. and OpenCode ( editor + BigPickle ) and ollama models.\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 190, "timestamp": 1784846632.784781, "date": "2026-07-23", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 124210, "response_tokens": 610} -->

Dark theme styling\n        self.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n            QDialog {\n                background-color: #1a1a1a;\n            }\n            QLabel {\n                color: #ffffff;\n            }\n            QLabel#header {\n                font-size: 18px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n                color: #ffffff;\n            }\n            QLabel#description {\n                color: #aaaaaa;\n                font-size: 13px;\n            }\n            QCheckBox {\n                color: #ffffff;\n                spacing: 8px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n            }\n            QCheckBox::indicator {\n                width: 18px;\n                height: 18px;\n            }\n            QPushButton {\n                background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                color: #ffffff;\n                border: 1px solid #555555;\n                padding: 10px 20px;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                font-size: 14px;\n                font-weight: bold;\n            }\n            QPushButton:hover {\n                background-color: #5a5a5a;\n            }\n            QPushButton:pressed {\n                background-color: #6a6a6a;\n            }\n            QScrollArea {\n                border: 1px solid #444444;\n                background-color: #2d2d2d;\n            }\n            QFrame#gadgetItem {\n                background-color: #2d2d2d;\n                border: 1px solid #444444;\n                border-radius: 5px;\n                padding: 10px;\n            }\n            QFrame#gadgetItem:hover {\n                background-color: #3d3d3d;\n                border-color: #555555;\n            }\n        \"\"\")\n        \n        self.setup_ui()\n    \n    def setup_ui(self):\n        \"\"\"Setup the dialog UI\"\"\"\n        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)\n        layout.setSpacing(15)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(20, 20, 20, 20)\n        \n        # Header\n        header = QLabel(\"\u2699\ufe0f Gadget Configuration\")\n        header.setObjectName(\"header\")\n        layout.addWidget(header)\n        \n        # Description\n        desc = QLabel(\"Enable or disable gadgets to customize your panel\")\n        desc.setObjectName(\"description\")\n        desc.setWordWrap(True)\n        layout.addWidget(desc)\n        \n        # Scroll area for gadgets\n        scroll = QScrollArea()\n        scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)\n        scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)\n        \n        # Container for gadgets\n        container = QWidget()\n        container_layout = QVBoxLayout(container)\n        container_layout.setSpacing(10)\n        container_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignTop)\n        \n        # Get available gadgets\n        available = self.gadget_manager.get_available_gadgets()\n        \n        if not available:\n            label = QLabel(\"No gadgets available\")\n            label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)\n            label.setStyleSheet(\"color: #888888; font-style: italic; padding: 50px;\")\n            container_layout.addWidget(label)\n        else:\n            for gadget_name in available:\n                info = self.gadget_manager.get_gadget_info(gadget_name)\n                if info:\n                    self._create_gadget_item(container_layout, info)\n        \n        container_layout.addStretch()\n        scroll.setWidget(container)\n        layout.addWidget(scroll)\n        \n        # Buttons\n        btn_layout = QHBoxLayout()\n        \n        reload_btn = QPushButton(\"\ud83d\udd04 Reload\")\n        reload_btn.setToolTip(\"Reload gadgets from disk\")\n        reload_btn.clicked.connect(self.reload_gadgets)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(reload_btn)\n        \n        btn_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        cancel_btn = QPushButton(\"Cancel\")\n        cancel_btn.clicked.connect(self.reject)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(cancel_btn)\n        \n        save_btn = QPushButton(\"\ud83d\udcbe Save\")\n        save_btn.setDefault(True)\n        save_btn.clicked.connect(self.save_config)\n        btn_layout.addWidget(save_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_layout)\n    \n    def _create_gadget_item(self, layout, info):\n        \"\"\"Create a widget for a single gadget\"\"\"\n        frame = QFrame()\n        frame.setObjectName(\"gadgetItem\")\n        frame_layout = QHBoxLayout(frame)\n        frame_layout.setSpacing(10)\n        \n        # Checkbox for enabling\n        checkbox = QCheckBox(f\"{info['icon']} {info['name']}\")\n        checkbox.setChecked(info['enabled'])\n        checkbox.setToolTip(info['description'])\n        self.checkboxes[info['name']] = checkbox\n        frame_layout.addWidget(checkbox)\n        \n        frame_layout.addStretch()\n        \n        # Source label\n        source = info.get('source', 'unknown')\n        source_label = QLabel(f\"[{source}]\")\n        source_label.setStyleSheet(\"color: #888888; font-size: 11px;\")\n        frame_layout.addWidget(source_label)\n        \n        layout.addWidget(frame)\n        \n        # Description below\n        if info.get('description'):\n            desc = QLabel(info['description'])\n            desc.setObjectName(\"description\")\n            desc.setWordWrap(True)\n            desc.setIndent(30)  # Align with checkbox\n            layout.addWidget(desc)\n    \n    def save_config(self):\n        \"\"\"Save the configuration\"\"\"\n        for gadget_name, checkbox in self.checkboxes.items():\n            if checkbox.isChecked():\n                self.gadget_manager.enable_gadget(gadget_name)\n            else:\n                self.gadget_manager.disable_gadget(gadget_name)\n        \n        self.accept()\n    \n    def reload_gadgets(self):\n        \"\"\"Reload gadgets from disk\"\"\"\n        reply = QMessageBox.question(\n            self,\n            \"Reload Gadgets\",\n            \"This will reload all gadgets from disk. Continue?\",\n            QMessageBox.Yes | QMessageBox.No\n        )\n        \n        if reply == QMessageBox.Yes:\n            self.gadget_manager.reload_gadgets()\n            # Refresh UI\n            self.close()\n            dialog = GadgetConfigDialog(self.gadget_manager, self.parent())\n            dialog.exec_()\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 204, "timestamp": 1784895788.6390293, "date": "2026-07-24", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 169955, "response_tokens": 1451} -->

Scan each directory in Menus as a top-level menu\n        for menu_dir in sorted(self.menus_dir.iterdir()):\n            if menu_dir.is_dir() and menu_dir.name != '__pycache__':\n                menu_data = self._scan_menu_directory(menu_dir)\n                if menu_data:\n                    menus.append(menu_data)\n        \n        return menus\n    \n    def _scan_menu_directory(self, directory):\n        \"\"\"Recursively scan a menu directory\"\"\"\n        items = []\n        \n        for item_path in sorted(directory.iterdir()):\n            if item_path.name == '__pycache__':\n                continue\n            \n            if item_path.is_dir():\n                # Check if this subfolder has config.json (leaf menu)\n                config_file = item_path / \"config.json\"\n                if config_file.exists():\n                    # Leaf menu - add as clickable item\n                    try:\n                        with open(config_file) as f:\n                            config = json.load(f)\n                        items.append({\n                            \"name\": item_path.name,\n                            \"type\": \"leaf\",\n                            \"config\": config,\n                            \"path\": item_path\n                        })\n                    except Exception as e:\n                        print(f\"Error loading config {config_file}: {e}\")\n                else:\n                    # Branch menu - recurse\n                    submenu = self._scan_menu_directory(item_path)\n                    if submenu:\n                        submenu[\"name\"] = item_path.name\n                        submenu[\"type\"] = \"branch\"\n                        items.append(submenu)\n            elif item_path.suffix == '.py' and item_path.name != '__init__.py':\n                # Python script - add as runnable script\n                items.append({\n                    \"name\": item_path.stem,\n                    \"type\": \"script\",\n                    \"path\": str(item_path)\n                })\n        \n        # Return as branch menu if has items\n        if items:\n            return {\n                \"name\": directory.name,\n                \"type\": \"branch\",\n                \"items\": items\n            }\n        \n        return None\n    \n    def _run_script(self, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run a menu script with run() function\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"menu_script\", script_path)\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                # Pass parent window to script\n                module.run(self.parent)\n            else:\n                print(f\"No run() function in {script_path}\")\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running script {script_path}: {e}\")\n            QMessageBox.critical(\n                self.parent,\n                \"Error\",\n                f\"Failed to run script:\\n{e}\"\n            )\n    \n    def _open_leaf_menu(self, menu_data):\n        \"\"\"Show window with content from folder's config.json\"\"\"\n        config = menu_data.get(\"config\", {})\n        path = menu_data.get(\"path\")\n        \n        if not path:\n            return\n        \n        # Use longer delay to let menu close first (prevents freeze)\n        self._pending_dialog = (config, path)\n        QTimer.singleShot(100, self._show_pending_dialog)\n    \n    def _show_pending_dialog(self):\n        \"\"\"Show the pending dialog\"\"\"\n        if self._pending_dialog:\n            config, path = self._pending_dialog\n            self._show_leaf_dialog(config, path)\n            self._pending_dialog = None\n    \n    def _show_leaf_dialog(self, config, path):\n        \"\"\"Actually show the leaf dialog\"\"\"\n        # Get settings from config\n        content_file = config.get('windowContent', '')\n        script_cmd = config.get('windowScript', '')\n        loop_interval = config.get('loop', 0)\n        looptype = config.get('looptype', 'second')\n        title = config.get('title', path.name)\n        \n        # Create window\n        dialog = QDialog(self.parent)\n        dialog.setWindowTitle(title)\n        dialog.setGeometry(100, 100, 600, 400)\n        \n        # Dark theme for all leaf menus\n        if script_cmd:\n            # Terminal-like for script output\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #000000; \n                    color: #00ff00; \n                    border: 1px solid #333333;\n                    border-radius: 3px;\n                    padding: 10px;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 11px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: #ffffff;\n                    border: 1px solid #555555;\n                    padding: 10px 20px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                    font-weight: bold;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover {\n                    background-color: #5a5a5a;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n        else:\n            # Dark theme for static content\n            dialog.setStyleSheet(\"\"\"\n                QDialog { background-color: #1a1a1a; }\n                QTextEdit { \n                    background-color: #2d2d2d; \n                    color: #ffffff; \n                    border: 1px solid #444444;\n                    border-radius: 3px;\n                    padding: 10px;\n                    font-family: monospace;\n                    font-size: 12px;\n                }\n                QPushButton {\n                    background-color: #4a4a4a;\n                    color: #ffffff;\n                    border: 1px solid #555555;\n                    padding: 10px 20px;\n                    border-radius: 4px;\n                    font-weight: bold;\n                }\n                QPushButton:hover {\n                    background-color: #5a5a5a;\n                }\n            \"\"\")\n        \n        layout = QVBoxLayout(dialog)\n        layout.setSpacing(10)\n        layout.setContentsMargins(10, 10, 10, 10)\n        \n        # Text widget\n        text = QTextEdit()\n        text.setReadOnly(True)\n        layout.addWidget(text)\n        \n        # Button frame\n        btn_frame = QHBoxLayout()\n        btn_frame.addStretch()\n        \n        # Check for ok.py\n        ok_script = path / \"ok.py\"\n        if ok_script.exists():\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(lambda: self._run_ok_script(dialog, ok_script))\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        else:\n            ok_btn = QPushButton(\"OK\")\n            ok_btn.clicked.connect(dialog.accept)\n            btn_frame.addWidget(ok_btn)\n        \n        layout.addLayout(btn_frame)\n        \n        # Handle script command (looping)\n        if script_cmd:\n            interval_ms = loop_interval * 1000 if looptype == 'second' else loop_interval\n            \n            def update_output():\n                try:\n                    result = subprocess.run(\n                        script_cmd, \n                        shell=True, \n                        capture_output=True, \n                        text=True, \n                        timeout=10\n                    )\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(result.stdout if result.stdout else result.stderr)\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.clear()\n                    text.setText(str(e))\n                \n                # Schedule next update if window still exists and looping enabled\n                if dialog.isVisible() and loop_interval > 0:\n                    QTimer.singleShot(interval_ms, update_output)\n            \n            # Initial run\n            update_output()\n        else:\n            # Static content\n            if content_file:\n                full_path = path / content_file\n                try:\n                    with open(full_path, 'r') as f:\n                        text.setText(f.read())\n                except FileNotFoundError:\n                    text.setText(f\"Content not found: {content_file}\")\n                except Exception as e:\n                    text.setText(f\"Error reading content: {e}\")\n        \n        dialog.show()\n        dialog.raise_()\n        dialog.activateWindow()\n    \n    def _run_ok_script(self, window, script_path):\n        \"\"\"Run ok.py script and close window\"\"\"\n        try:\n            spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(\"ok_script\", str(script_path))\n            module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)\n            spec.loader.exec_module(module)\n            if hasattr(module, 'run'):\n                module.run(window)\n            else:\n                window.accept()\n        except Exception as e:\n            print(f\"Error running ok.py: {e}\")\n            window.accept()\n    \n    def _populate_menu(self, menu, items):\n        \"\"\"Populate a menu with items\"\"\"\n        for item in items:\n            if item.get(\"type\") == \"separator\":\n                menu.addSeparator()\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"branch\":\n                # Create nested submenu\n                submenu = menu.addMenu(item[\"name\"])\n                self._populate_menu(submenu, item.get(\"items\", []))\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"script\":\n                # Python script - run with run()\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                script_path = item[\"path\"]\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, p=script_path: self._run_script(p)\n                )\n            elif item.get(\"type\") == \"leaf\":\n                # Leaf menu - open content window\n                action = menu.addAction(item[\"name\"])\n                action.triggered.connect(\n                    lambda checked, m=item: self._open_leaf_menu(m)\n                )\n</contentOfFile>\n</WriteFile>", "sessionId": 332, "rowId": 204, "timestamp": 1784895846.4964774, "date": "2026-07-24", "thinking": "", "prompt_tokens": 174268, "response_tokens": 2193} -->
